COD.rationale: Identified content (red) with spatial grouping and a separate origin/status field are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation claim linked to a content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific content sets (color 'red') for a named referent.

D.rationale: A separate origin/status field (executed_branch_claim, kind, represented_time) attributes status to the identified content.

O.rationale: The coordinate set shows how the content is organized/presented (a 2x2 spatial grouping).
